truth-table.label: Valid inference
truth-table.description: From SUN ∨ RAIN and ¬SUN, infer RAIN. Test the premises together with ¬RAIN.

truth-table.label: Invalid inference
truth-table.description: From SUN ∨ RAIN and SUN, infer ¬RAIN. Test the premises together with ¬¬RAIN.

truth-table.label: Circuit verification
truth-table.description: Compare the NAND specification S with the relay circuit C = ¬(INPUT₁ ∧ INPUT₂). Test ¬(S ↔ C), with S and C expanded below.

truth-table.label: Faulty circuit
truth-table.description: The lamp is connected before the negating relay. Compare this circuit with the same NAND specification.

truth-table.label: Three variables
truth-table.description: From SUN ∨ (¬RAIN ∧ ¬WIND) and SUN, infer WIND. Test the premises together with ¬WIND.

truth-table.label: Circuit: DNF specification
truth-table.description: Use the true-row descriptions S₁ for the same NAND specification. Compare the result with Circuit verification, which uses S.

resolution.label: Valid inference
resolution.description: From SUN ∨ RAIN and ¬SUN, infer RAIN. Test the premises together with ¬RAIN.

resolution.label: Invalid inference
resolution.description: From SUN ∨ RAIN and SUN, infer ¬RAIN. Test the premises together with ¬¬RAIN.

resolution.label: Circuit verification
resolution.description: Compare the NAND specification S with the relay circuit C = ¬(INPUT₁ ∧ INPUT₂). Test ¬(S ↔ C), with S and C expanded below.

resolution.label: Faulty circuit
resolution.description: The lamp is connected before the negating relay. Compare this circuit with the same NAND specification.

rewrite.label: Negations
rewrite.description: Push negations inward, then convert to CNF or DNF.

rewrite.label: Distribution growth
rewrite.description: Three conjunctions joined by ∨: compare ordinary distribution with fresh subformula names.

rewrite.label: Circuit verification
rewrite.description: Compare the NAND specification S with the relay circuit C = ¬(INPUT₁ ∧ INPUT₂). Test ¬(S ↔ C), with S and C expanded below.

tseytin.label: Conjunction and disjunction
tseytin.description: Name SUN ∧ RAIN first, then name its disjunction with WIND.

tseytin.label: Contradiction
tseytin.description: Transform SUN ∧ ¬SUN and assert the root; the resulting CNF is unsatisfiable too.

tseytin.label: Distribution growth
tseytin.description: Three conjunctions joined by ∨: compare ordinary distribution with fresh subformula names.

tseytin.label: Circuit verification
tseytin.description: Compare the NAND specification S with the relay circuit C = ¬(INPUT₁ ∧ INPUT₂). Test ¬(S ↔ C), with S and C expanded below.
